releases.notes:
**Version 2.04.0:**

- Port to Minecraft 1.21.1, 1.21.11, and 26.1.2
- Added a bunch of new post types: Pale Oak, Granite, Diorite, Andesite, Tuff, Deepslate, Basalt, Blackstone, Nether Brick, Prismarine, Amethyst, and Red Sandstone
- Sign posts are no longer one block per material: the post type is now data, so data packs and other mods can add their own post types
- Fixed stone posts turning into sandstone when broken

Please backup your maps, report any bugs and have fun :D

releases.notes:
**Version 2.01.0**

- Readded Waystones compat and enhanced it. You can now teleport to those waystones unless this option was disabled in the config.
- Added Repurposed Structures compat. Sign posts and waystones will now generate in those villages as well.
- Added mushroom sign posts.
- You can now pick up a waystone and move it by using silk touch (survival) or the creative pick block feature. The waystone will now keep its name and once it is placed (provided the original was destroyed), all sign posts that pointed to it will update to target the new position. You can reshape the waystone using the stonecutter or rename it using an anvil before you place it again.
- Btw: You move sign posts like this as well.
- Newly created signs will now update when the waystone's name is changed if its text was exactly the old name.
- Added a COMMON config for world_gen defaults When creating a new world, its server config will be initialized with the values from there. The server config also has an option to disable itself, in which case the common config will always be used.
- Fixed a crash when using the newest forge versions.

Please backup your maps, report any bugs and have fun :D
